concerns.text: Task T001 is marked `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but it creates project directories and shared utilities that are consumed by virtually every subsequent task. Running it in parallel with those consumers could cause race conditions; the `[P]` tag is therefore unsafe.

Task T012 is also marked `[P]` yet it executes the full end‑to‑end pipeline, writing all artifacts. Parallel execution with any other task would lead to file‑write conflicts, so the `[P]` designation is invalid.

User‑story 3 tasks (T008, T009, T010, T014, T015, T011) depend on outputs from User‑story 2 (e.g., descriptors from T004, model from T006). This violates the rule that tasks within a US block must form an independently‑shippable unit; US3 cannot be tested end‑to‑end without completing US2.
